title: VF-009 triage: a class initializer that throws, on the JVM, in stock JBMC 6.11.0 and through jvmcontract's JBMC adapter
description: Triage for VF-009 (verification/findings.md), item J1 of llm-dlc/loops/cleanup-jbmc.md; it closes nothing. Under auto --confirm, JBMC 6.11.0 refutes conformance boomTwice (result == 2) and enumBroken (result == 12) at n=0, where the JVM and the tool's own checker hold (job 20261107-010728, step 2). Both methods run a class initializer that throws; the JVM wraps the throw in ExceptionInInitializerError (JVMS 5.5 step 11) and raises NoClassDefFoundError at the class's next use (step 5). JBMC's goto program sets clinit_already_run before it calls <clinit>, as the preflight's test fixtures show, so the hypothesis is that JBMC neither wraps the exception nor marks the class erroneous. Step 1 runs the new fixture lib/tests/fixtures/jbmc-defects/F.java, one void method per part of the semantics (wrapped, erroneous, once, error, enumWrapped, and copies of boomTwice and enumBroken), on the JVM (java -ea, where every assertion holds) and on stock JBMC with no flags, with --throw-runtime-exceptions alone, and with the flags jvmcontract passes; then the goto listings of the two copies. Step 2 runs the corpus's own two methods through jvmcontract prove under --engine jbmc and auto --confirm, keeping each run's work directory (JBMC's JSON output with its trace in jbmc.log), to tell JBMC's semantics from the adapter's reading of the trace. Evidence, not a pass/fail check: a VERIFICATION FAILED is expected where JBMC differs from the JVM.
expected: Both steps exit 0. Step 1: java prints 'all hold, runs 4'. The hypothesis holds if JBMC fails wrapped, erroneous, once (or not, if it never reruns), enumWrapped, boomTwice and enumBroken under --throw-runtime-exceptions, and passes error; the log says which. Step 2: the prove log names JBMC's verdict and failed property for each run; the work directories keep JBMC's trace.

resources.notes: a clean release build of lib (a few minutes at 8 jobs), 21 JBMC runs on a 7-method fixture (seconds each), 6 jvmcontract proofs of one-line claims (job -010728 took about 20 min for 332 runs)

steps.name: the fixture on the JVM and stock JBMC
steps.run: set -o pipefail; d=lib/target/vf009; rm -rf $d; mkdir -p $d/f && javac -g -d $d/f lib/tests/fixtures/jbmc-defects/F.java && (echo "== java -ea F"; java -ea -cp $d/f F; echo "exit $?"; for f in wrapped erroneous once error enumWrapped boomTwice enumBroken; do for flags in "" "--throw-runtime-exceptions" "--trace --throw-runtime-exceptions --unwinding-assertions --unwind 16 --no-refine-strings --sat-solver cadical"; do echo "== jbmc F --function F.$f $flags"; timeout 300 jbmc F --function F.$f --classpath $d/f $flags; echo "exit $?"; done; done; for f in boomTwice enumBroken; do echo "== jbmc F --function F.$f --throw-runtime-exceptions --show-goto-functions"; timeout 120 jbmc F --function F.$f --classpath $d/f --throw-runtime-exceptions --show-goto-functions; echo "exit $?"; done) > $d/f.log 2>&1; grep -E "^(==|exit|VERIFICATION|\\[.*\\] .*FAILURE|all hold)" $d/f.log

steps.name: the corpus methods through jvmcontract
steps.run: set -o pipefail; cd lib && cargo build --release && d=target/vf009 && mkdir -p $d/c && javac -parameters -g -proc:none -d $d/c tests/conformance/conformance/Conformance.java && (for m in "boomTwice|result == 2" "enumBroken|result == 12"; do name=${m%%|*}; claim=${m#*|}; for mode in "jbmc strict" "auto strict confirm" "auto assume confirm"; do set -- $mode; extra=; [ "$3" = confirm ] && extra=--confirm; echo "== prove conformance.Conformance#$name --assert \"$claim\" --engine $1 --gaps $2 $extra"; JVMCONTRACT_JBMC_MEMORY_MB=2048 ./target/release/jvmcontract prove "conformance.Conformance#$name" --classes $d/c --assert "$claim" --engine $1 --gaps $2 $extra --work $d/work/$name-$1-$2$extra; echo "exit $?"; done; done) 2>&1 | tee $d/prove.log
